market-performance.description: Indian and global market performance with risk and return measures.

reer-world-bank.description: Annual real effective exchange rate for India and peers.

digital-integration.description: Is digital-payment adoption occurring alongside deeper participation and stronger tax capacity?

government-investment.description: Is central-government spending shifting toward productive assets, and are budget plans delivered?

private-investment.description: Is public infrastructure investment associated with firms expanding productive capacity?

fiscal-capacity.description: Can general-government investment be sustained without debt service crowding out future spending?

external-competitiveness.description: Is domestic growth occurring without persistent deterioration in external competitiveness?

human-capital.description: Is higher-education expansion translating into productive employment?

capital-resilience.description: Has domestic institutional investment reduced market sensitivity to foreign portfolio outflows?

indicators.title: UPI transactions per capita
indicators.summary: Monthly UPI transaction count divided by calendar-year population.

views.label: Time series
views.note: Annual population denominators make within-year changes entirely transaction-driven.

indicators.title: UPI value as share of GDP
indicators.summary: Trailing twelve-month UPI value relative to nominal GDP in current INR.

views.label: Time series
views.note: UPI value includes transfers and is not value added; early months lack a 12-month window.

indicators.title: Average UPI transaction value
indicators.summary: Average value of reported UPI transactions.

views.label: Time series
views.note: Mix shifts between person-to-person and merchant payments affect the average.

indicators.title: GST revenue growth minus nominal GDP growth
indicators.summary: Annual gross GST-revenue growth less matching fiscal-year nominal-GDP growth.

views.label: Time series
views.note: Tax-rate, enforcement, refunds, imports and collection timing also affect gross GST receipts.

indicators.title: Actual central-government capital expenditure
indicators.summary: Direct central-government capital expenditure as a share of nominal GDP.

views.label: Time series
views.note: Excludes broader effective CapEx unless separately labelled.

indicators.title: Actual CapEx share of expenditure
indicators.summary: Actual capital expenditure as a share of actual total expenditure.

views.label: Time series
views.note: Accounting classification does not measure asset quality.

indicators.title: CapEx execution ratio
indicators.summary: Actual capital expenditure relative to the original Budget Estimate.

views.label: Time series
views.note: A ratio above 100 may reflect supplemental spending rather than superior execution.

indicators.title: Capital expenditure — Budget Estimate
indicators.summary: Original central-government capital expenditure plan.

views.label: Time series
views.note: Budget estimates are plans, not delivered spending.

indicators.title: Capital expenditure — Revised Estimate
indicators.summary: In-year revised central-government capital expenditure plan.

views.label: Time series
views.note: Revised estimates remain estimates.

indicators.title: Capital expenditure — Actual
indicators.summary: Out-turn central-government capital expenditure.

views.label: Time series
views.note: Latest actuals lag budget estimates.

indicators.title: Private corporate GFCF
indicators.summary: Private corporate fixed investment relative to nominal GDP.

views.label: Time series
views.note: Institutional-sector revisions and base-year changes create breaks.

indicators.title: Private corporate share of GFCF
indicators.summary: Private corporate share of total fixed-capital formation.

views.label: Time series
views.note: This is not the whole private sector if household investment is excluded.

indicators.title: Manufacturing capacity utilisation
indicators.summary: Unadjusted aggregate manufacturing capacity utilisation.

views.label: Time series
views.note: OBICUS is a voluntary survey and does not cover the entire manufacturing universe.

indicators.title: Public CapEx, lagged one year
indicators.summary: Actual central-government CapEx/GDP shifted forward one year for visual comparison.

views.label: Time series
views.note: A chosen lag is descriptive and not a causal estimate.

indicators.title: General-government debt
indicators.summary: General-government debt stock relative to GDP.

views.label: Time series
views.note: Coverage must remain consistent across vintages.

indicators.title: Interest payments as share of revenue
indicators.summary: Central-government interest payments relative to revenue receipts.

views.label: Time series
views.note: Central-government burden is narrower than general-government debt.

indicators.title: Interest payments as share of expenditure
indicators.summary: Interest payments relative to total expenditure.

views.label: Time series
views.note: Changes in total expenditure alter the ratio independently of interest costs.

indicators.title: Primary balance
indicators.summary: Primary balance using negative values for deficits.

views.label: Time series
views.note: Sign convention must be retained in presentation.

indicators.title: Central-government debt
indicators.summary: Central-government debt as a secondary decomposition series.

views.label: Time series
views.note: Not comparable to general-government debt.

indicators.title: Trade-weighted REER
indicators.summary: RBI trade-weighted real effective exchange-rate index.

views.label: Time series
views.note: RBI may revise weights and base periods.

indicators.title: REER deviation from five-year average
indicators.summary: Percentage deviation from the trailing 60-month mean.

views.label: Time series
views.note: The historical mean is a reference, not fair value.

indicators.title: Current-account balance
indicators.summary: Current-account balance as a share of GDP; deficits are negative.

views.label: Time series
views.note: Quarterly GDP and balance-of-payments revisions must use matching vintages.

indicators.title: Non-oil merchandise export growth
indicators.summary: Year-on-year growth in non-oil merchandise exports.

views.label: Time series
views.note: Classification and price effects influence nominal export growth.

indicators.title: Tertiary Gross Enrolment Ratio
indicators.summary: Participation in tertiary education among the official age cohort.

views.label: Time series
views.note: AISHE revisions and institution coverage must be preserved.

indicators.title: Secondary-and-above unemployment rate
indicators.summary: Published unemployment rate among people aged 15+ with secondary-or-higher education using usual status.

views.label: Time series
views.note: The published aggregate is broader than graduate unemployment; it excludes people outside the labour force and can rise with participation.

indicators.title: Regular wage or salaried employment share
indicators.summary: Share of employed people aged 15+ in regular wage or salaried work.

views.label: Time series
views.note: Regular salaried work is not synonymous with formal or high-quality employment.

sections.label: Domestic capital buffer against global shocks

indicators.title: DII net equity flow
indicators.summary: Monthly sum of official daily net DII equity activity.

views.label: Time series
views.note: Exchange activity definitions and coverage must remain stable.

indicators.title: FII/FPI net equity flow
indicators.summary: Monthly sum of official daily net FII/FPI equity activity.

views.label: Time series
views.note: NSE activity is not identical to NSDL custodial flow data.

indicators.title: DII rolling 12-month flow
indicators.summary: Trailing 12-month cumulative DII flow.

views.label: Time series
views.note: Early observations lack a full window.

indicators.title: FPI rolling 12-month flow
indicators.summary: Trailing 12-month cumulative FPI flow.

views.label: Time series
views.note: Early observations lack a full window.

indicators.title: DII offset ratio
indicators.summary: Domestic buying divided by the magnitude of foreign selling in FPI selling months; null otherwise.

views.label: Time series
views.note: Ratios above one do not imply that DII caused market stability.

indicators.title: India vs global equity performance
indicators.summary: Compare Indian benchmarks with major global markets on a normalized basis and inspect the underlying risk-return bundle.

indicators.title: Real Effective Exchange Rate
indicators.summary: Track India’s external price competitiveness against its own history and peer economies without treating one level as proof of misvaluation.

indicators.title: Central government debt
indicators.summary: Compare central-government debt relative to GDP while retaining the exact coverage definition.

indicators.title: Labour force participation
indicators.summary: Measure the share of working-age people who are employed or actively seeking work.

indicators.title: Female-to-male LFPR ratio
indicators.summary: Track the gender gap in economic participation across India and peer economies.

indicators.title: Working-age population share
indicators.summary: Track demographic capacity in the population’s main productive years.

indicators.title: Urban population
indicators.summary: Follow the structural shift toward urban settlement as a share of total population.

indicators.title: Adult literacy rate
indicators.summary: Compare foundational human-capital attainment across India and peers.

indicators.title: Secondary gross enrolment
indicators.summary: Measure participation in secondary education relative to the official age cohort.

indicators.title: Tertiary gross enrolment
indicators.summary: Track participation in higher education and the future skilled-worker pipeline.

indicators.title: Secondary education expenditure
indicators.summary: Compare government expenditure per secondary student across peer economies.

indicators.title: Medium- and high-technology exports
indicators.summary: Track movement toward more sophisticated manufacturing exports.

indicators.title: FDI net inflows
indicators.summary: Measure long-term foreign corporate investment relative to economic size.
